methodNote: baseline = the production comp-matching code as it runs today (bedrooms and property type only); size25_item2 = the same code with the proposed Phase B rules simulated

scope.county: the Ventura-area service box (Ventura, Oxnard, Camarillo, Simi Valley, Thousand Oaks and the Conejo Valley border); about 27% of the leases are in the Calabasas / Agoura Hills / Westlake Village / West Hills border area (also reported separately as "LA-border cities")

pool.mls: MLS closed leases from CRMLS (Recore) dated before the day each lease closed, 6-month lookback
pool.full: MLS leases plus as-of asking listings (original list price) plus Rincon's own leases (24-month lookback)
pool.rentcast: not included (RentCast as-of snapshot, A2, is not built); RentCast is about 45% of the comps staff see
pool.timing: as of the day before the lease closed; staff price a home at listing time (median gap 33 days in this data), so the figures are optimistic

regions.definition: "LA-border cities" are Westlake Village, Agoura Hills, Calabasas, West Hills, Woodland Hills, Malibu, Hidden Hills, Canoga Park, Agoura, Los Angeles; "Ventura-area excluding LA-border" is every other city in the box

rincon.description: Rincon single-home leases started in the last 12 months after the plausibility screen; signed rent is the target; pool = full (24-month Rincon lookback)
rincon.note: signed rent is not always market rent: a unit re-priced after sitting vacant signs below its first ask (no asking-price history exists yet, A3)

listingTimeCheck.description: MLS leases re-run as of the day they went on the market instead of the day before they closed
